opening.argument: The material directly promotes free Fandango coupons and movie value, with the title stating “Fandango Coupons - Free Fandango Movies” and the description directing viewers to an external coupon destination. The displayed offer further claims “Receive Your FREE FANDANGO BUCKS” and makes entering a ZIP code an explicit step toward claiming the advertised benefit. Together, these elements present a low-barrier reward-for-information flow rather than ordinary audience engagement. The destination’s legitimacy and whether any reward is delivered are not established, but the promotional structure and requested information support treating the offer as deceptive acquisition content.
